evals.expected_output: Captures PRODUCT.md/DESIGN.md via impeccable, runs critique, asks refine vs reinvent, picks refine (brand kept), applies targeted impeccable commands, finishes with audit + screenshots at two widths. Does not run Hallmark install-hook.

evals.expected_output: Impeccable critique/audit with native references, Compose changes via android-skills, verification with mobile MCP screenshot and element list on a device or emulator, gradle unit tests run.

evals.prompt: new marketing page for our sleep app, go through the impeccable structure roll
evals.expected_output: Runs impeccable concept-seed exactly once with output redirected to a file and reads the file; never reruns the seed just to see cut-off output.

evals.expected_output: Sets each viewport before loading, navigates with a fresh query string (not a hash-only change), scrolls to top and takes viewport-sized (tall) screenshots, not full-page ones; never resizes an already-loaded page to produce the phone capture.
